earnings.title: Analog Devices Reports Record Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Fourth quarter revenue of $4.37 billion, with year-over-year growth led by Data Center and Industrial
Fiscal 2026 revenue of $15.2 billion, up 38% versus 2025, a new high-water mark
Fiscal 2026 operating cash flow of $6.2 billion and free cash flow of $5.5 billion, or 41% and 36% of revenue, respectively
Returned $5.4 billion to shareholders in fiscal 2026 via dividends and share repurchases

quotes.text: ADI closed fiscal 2026 with record performance, demonstrating the continued strength of our business model.

Customers are relying on ADI more than ever, and our capital allocation reflects that. We are directing investment to three priorities: R&D that extends our technology leadership, capacity that secures supply for our customers’ growth, and consistent capital returns to our shareholders.

outlook: For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, we are forecasting revenue of $4.4 billion, +/- $150 million.
At the midpoint of this revenue outlook, we expect reported operating margin of approximately 40.3%, +/- 150 bps, and adjusted operating margin of approximately 50.5%, +/- 100 bps.
We are planning for reported EPS to be $3.02, +/- $0.20, and adjusted EPS to be $3.82, +/- $0.20.
